portableInvocation.rule: The canonical portable declaration is bare-command only. It relies on platform executable search and must not contain an arbitrary absolute command or a plugin-contained external executable.

proofMethod.requiredFor: Every released client integration that claims executable Legion access or Full fidelity.
proofMethod.environment: The actual client launch environment after setup, not an interactive developer shell, source checkout, test harness, or inherited test PATH.
steps: Install the signed, release-bound native Legion artifact through the qualifying machine package path.
Install or register the selected client integration through legion setup.
Capture the launch environment identity and effective executable search inputs without recording secrets.
Attempt the canonical bare invocation through the client's actual launcher.
Record the resolved executable canonical path, file identity, release version, artifact digest, and provenance.
Start one client-owned stdio MCP process, complete initialization, and verify release binding before tools are exposed.
Exercise initialization, invocation, cancellation, restart, and shutdown within the same client session to prove reuse and lifecycle ownership.
Repeat with PATH sanitized or stale as an adversarial fixture.
If bare lookup fails, attempt only the client's documented/supported native exact-path registration and repeat the same identity and lifecycle checks.
Classify the released fidelity from the evidence; never retain Full on an unresolved or source-checkout route.
passConditions: resolved path is the machine-installed native Legion executable for the expected OS/architecture
path does not reside in a source checkout, plugin package, temporary fixture, cache substitute, or another project's dependency tree
resolved binary digest and provenance match the release binding
server identity, capability catalog, MCP tool schema, and declarative asset/schema hashes match the bound release
one process is reused for repeated work in one active client session
no machine-wide idle daemon or per-tool Legion runtime birth occurs
the client owns cancellation, restart, and shutdown
a PATH-sanitized/stale-PATH case does not produce a false Full claim

perClientContract.target: Try the selected supported native plugin mechanism, then Agent Plugins bare-command launch. If the client cannot resolve legion, use only its supported native exact-path registration.
perClientContract.fullGate: All generic proof pass conditions plus claimed host-enforcement qualification.
perClientContract.failureDisposition: Degraded for a safe meaningful subset; Unavailable when no safe executable route exists.

perClientContract.target: Try the selected supported native plugin mechanism, then Agent Plugins bare-command launch, then a supported native exact-path MCP/config registration.
perClientContract.fullGate: All generic proof pass conditions plus qualified skill delivery and every claimed host surface.
perClientContract.failureDisposition: Degraded when only instruction-mediated skills or another safe subset remains; Baseline when no executable route is activated; Unavailable when requested installation is unsafe.

perClientContract.target: No executable resolution proof is applicable to the official M0 Baseline path.
perClientContract.fullGate: Not eligible until Pi promotion evidence selects a supported executable mechanism.
perClientContract.failureDisposition: Remain Baseline without executable claims, or Unavailable when the instruction/skill path cannot be installed safely.

fallbackContract.allowed: A client-specific supported native registration may contain the exact installed path only outside Agent Plugins mcp.json.
must: validate the exact path identity, containment, digest, provenance, and release binding
remain transactional and reversible through legion setup
forbidden: embedding the native binary into the portable package
disguising an external binary as a plugin-relative executable
claiming Full before fallback proof passes

Current adapter engine manufactures Node-plus-absolute-source-script MCP registrations.
